answer: To prevent sybil clusters, we use reputation escrow with activity aging. First, an agent locks 100 POA time-locked. Second, account matures 72 hours before mining weight. Third, daily activity releases reputation pigment tokens increasing vote power. Fourth, malicious acts burn the escrow. Attacker creating 500 identities needs 50,000 POA locked 3 days, making farms costly. This reputation is no fragile relic; it anchors the agent like a solid reef shielding a lagoon from storm waves.
